list.title: Asset inventory
list.subtitle: The information, systems, equipment, services and premises you rely on, who owns them and how they must be protected.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, name, serial number or vendor

classificationHelp.public: Public: may be shared with anyone.
classificationHelp.internal: Internal: for people in the organisation; little harm if it leaks.
classificationHelp.confidential: Confidential: only for those who need it; disclosure would cause harm.
classificationHelp.restricted: Restricted: a few named people only; disclosure would cause serious harm.

form.newSubtitle: Describe what it is, who is responsible and how it must be protected.
form.categoryPlaceholder: For example laptop, database, contract archive
form.cia: How much harm if it is disclosed, changed or unavailable
form.personalDataHint: Tick this if the asset stores or processes information about identifiable people.
form.handlingPlaceholder: For example: encrypt at rest, no copies on personal devices, shred paper copies
form.suggestionApplied: Suggestion applied. Check it before you save.
form.ownerHint: Leave empty to make yourself the owner.
form.disposalPlaceholder: For example certified wiping, shredding, returned to the supplier
form.retiredHint: Leave the dates empty to use today's date.
form.calibrationHint: For instruments whose readings you rely on to check products or services.
form.intervalHint: Between 1 and 120 months. Used to work out the next due date after each calibration.
form.lastCalibratedHint: If it was calibrated before you registered it.
form.changeReasonHint: Optional, but it helps whoever reads the revision history later.

detail.notFound: This asset does not exist or you do not have access to it.
detail.personalDataHint: This asset holds personal data. Make sure it is covered by your records of processing and that access is limited to those who need it.
detail.noChanges: No change requests concern this asset.
detail.noReviews: No access reviews for this system yet.
detail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} {{ name }} is removed from the inventory. Its history is kept for audits.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.nextDueDefault: Leave empty to use {{ date }} (the date plus the interval).
calibration.nextDueNoInterval: No interval is set, so enter the next due date yourself.
calibration.impactHint: A failed calibration means earlier measurements may be wrong. Describe which products or results could be affected and what you did about it.
calibration.deleteMessage: The record and its place in the calibration history are removed.
calibration.savedFailed: Calibration saved. The owner has been told it failed.

calibrationPage.title: Calibration due
calibrationPage.subtitle: Measuring equipment that is overdue or due for calibration soon.

reviews.title: Access reviews
reviews.subtitle: Regular checks that everyone with access to a system still needs it.
reviews.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, title or system

reviewForm.subtitle: Choose the system, who reviews it and by when.
reviewForm.closed: This review is closed and can no longer be changed.
reviewForm.titleHint: Leave empty to name it after the system.
reviewForm.scopePlaceholder: For example: all user and administrator accounts, including service accounts
reviewForm.frequencyHint: Leave empty for a one-off review. When set, the next review is planned automatically on completion.
reviewForm.frequencyInvalid: Enter a number of months between 1 and 60.
reviewForm.importMembers: Start with every member of the organisation as an account
reviewForm.importMembersHint: Useful when everyone in the organisation has an account in the system. You can remove accounts afterwards.
reviewForm.created: {{ code }} planned. The reviewer has been given a task.

reviewDetail.notFound: This access review does not exist or you do not have access to it.
reviewDetail.needItems: Add the accounts with access before the review can be completed.
reviewDetail.needDecisions: Decide every account before completing ({{ pending }} left).
reviewDetail.remediationTasks: {{ count }} access changes still to carry out. Remediation tasks have been created.
reviewDetail.readOnly: Only the reviewer or an asset manager can record decisions.
reviewDetail.completeMessage: You decided to revoke {{ revoke }} and change {{ modify }} accounts. Remediation tasks are created for these.
reviewDetail.attestationPlaceholder: I have reviewed all access to {{ system }} and confirm that the remaining access is needed and appropriate.
reviewDetail.cancelMessage: The reviewer's task is closed. Say why the review is no longer needed.
reviewDetail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} and its decisions are removed. Its history is kept for audits.

reviewItems.title: Accounts and decisions
reviewItems.none: No accounts yet. Add the accounts that have access to the system.
reviewItems.remediated: Done: the access has been changed

changes.title: Change requests
changes.subtitle: Planned changes that are assessed, approved, carried out and reviewed in a controlled way.

changeForm.subtitle: Describe the change and why it is needed. The assessment can be filled in now or during the assessment step.
changeForm.lockedNote: The change has been assessed or approved, so the approved content can no longer be edited. Raise a new change if the plan must change.

placeholders.reason: Why the change is needed, and what happens if it is not made
placeholders.impactAssessment: Who and what is affected: users, systems, customers, processes, documents
placeholders.riskAssessment: What could go wrong, how likely, and how you reduce it
placeholders.implementationPlan: The steps, who does them and when
placeholders.rollbackPlan: How you go back if something goes wrong
placeholders.reviewNotes: Did the change achieve its purpose? Any side effects?
placeholders.implementedAt: The date it was carried out

changeForm.assessmentApplied: Assessment suggestion filled into the empty fields. Check it before you save.

changeStep.title: Before the next step

intro.draft: Describe the change and the reason for it before you submit it for assessment.
intro.assessment: Fill in the impact assessment, the risk level and the implementation plan before you ask for approval.
intro.implementing: Enter the date the change was carried out before you mark the implementation as done.
intro.review: Record the outcome of the post-implementation review before you close the change.

changeStep.saved: Saved. You can take the next step now.

changeDetail.notFound: This change request does not exist or you do not have access to it.
changeDetail.locked: The approved content is frozen. Only the dates, owner and the implementation and review details can still be changed.
changeDetail.assetsHint: Link more assets, documents or risks under Related.
changeDetail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} {{ title }} is removed. Its history is kept for audits.

prompts.overview: Give me an overview of our asset inventory: what types of assets we have, which are critical or restricted, which have no owner, and what needs attention.
prompts.summarise: Summarise this asset: what it is, how it is classified and why, who is responsible, its lifecycle and anything that needs attention.
prompts.classification: Help me choose the right classification for this asset. Explain the levels and what each means for how it must be handled.
prompts.controls: Which security controls are most relevant for this asset given its type and classification, and are any missing?
prompts.calibrationPlan: Which measuring equipment is overdue or due for calibration soon, and how should we plan the work?
prompts.reviewsOverview: Give me an overview of our access reviews: which are overdue, which are in progress and which systems have not been reviewed recently.
prompts.reviewHelp: Help me carry out this access review. What should I check for each account, and when should access be revoked or changed?
prompts.changesOverview: Give me an overview of our open change requests: what is waiting for assessment or approval, what is being implemented and what is high risk.
prompts.summariseChange: Summarise this change request: what changes and why, the risk, where it is in the process and what the next step is.
prompts.riskLevel: How should I decide the risk level of this change? What makes a change low, medium, high or critical risk?
prompts.reviewAssessment: Review the impact and risk assessment of this change. Is anything missing, and is the rollback plan good enough?

errors.invalid: Some values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.attestation_required: Write the attestation before completing the review.
errors.change_closed: This change request is closed and can no longer be edited.
errors.change_locked: The change has been assessed or approved, so its approved content can no longer be edited ({{ count }} fields).
errors.invalid_asset: One of the chosen assets no longer exists.
errors.invalid_calibration_interval: The calibration interval must be between 1 and 120 months.
errors.invalid_custodian: The custodian must be a member of the organisation.
errors.invalid_dates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.invalid_department: Choose a department in this organisation.
errors.invalid_frequency: The repeat interval must be between 1 and 60 months.
errors.invalid_owner: The owner must be a member of the organisation.
errors.invalid_reviewer: The reviewer must be a member of the organisation.
errors.invalid_subject_user: The account holder must be a member of the organisation.
errors.invalid_system_asset: Choose a system from the inventory.
errors.module_disabled: Assets and changes is not switched on for this organisation.
errors.nothing_to_remediate: Only revoked or changed access can be marked as done.
errors.review_closed: This access review is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.review_empty: Add at least one account before completing the review.
errors.review_not_planned: Only a planned review can be started.
errors.too_many_assets: A change can list at most 50 assets. Link more under Related.
errors.too_many_items: Too many accounts at once (500 at most).
errors.workflow_unavailable: The change workflow is not available. Ask an administrator to check the change request record type.
